niche_preference_profile: Prefers light, neutral, card-based interfaces with clear hierarchy, labeled actions, and restrained purple accents. Favors organized layouts with subtle elevation, rounded containers, compact but readable spacing, and semantic information encoding. Dislikes dark high-contrast themes, oversized decorative icons, icon-only controls, floating or flat states, and visually dramatic presentations that weaken clarity.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral backgrounds, soft gray surfaces, dark text, and restrained purple accents over dark, high-contrast color schemes.
Prefers interfaces with strong section separation, readable structure, explicit headers/instructions, and content-first hierarchy.
Prefers content placed inside clear cards or rounded containers with subtle separation rather than floating directly on the page.
Prefers text-labeled actions, numbered badges, visible drag handles, and explicit cues over icon-only or subtle controls.
Prefers balanced, open spacing that groups elements neatly and avoids both crowding and empty space caused by oversized decorative elements.
Prefers polished, approachable, low-clutter interfaces with small contained icons and minimal decoration rather than dramatic or oversized graphic treatments.
Prefers subtle shadows, rounded corners, and softer lower-contrast focal elements that create gentle depth and focus.
